inputs.prompt: The adult female fantasy knight in <Picture 1>, preserve her illustrated art style, face, blonde ponytail, blue cape, silver and gold armor, boots and full length sword. She walks briskly in place facing right. Alternating full steps with heel strike and toe off, natural weight transfer through hips, subtle torso rotation and vertical bounce, head follows the torso naturally. Arms counter-swing, ponytail and cape lag and sway. Repeat several coherent walking cycles. Fixed side view camera, full body visible with ample margin around her hair, feet and sword. Single character centered on perfectly uniform bright green chroma key background. Flat illustrated colors and crisp edges. Each frame is sharply drawn without motion blur. No camera movement, no scene changes, no text, no floor shadow. Silent. The knight occupies only the central 60 percent of the canvas height, with broad empty green margins on all four sides. Keep her entire sword, hair and cape within the frame throughout. The background is a perfectly flat solid RGB green screen with no texture, pattern, grid or gradients. No sword glow, no magical effects, no trails.
